- we are starting a new monthly podcast with a radio station, featuring longer form conversations
with the ADIC. The first topic they asked us to cover is human trafficking. The ADIC has a pretty good handle
on a lot of the information, but wanted to get him some examples of recent cases. I've pasted below links to
three recent cases - are there any more you think would be worth highlighting. Time frame I think would be
last four months or so. Also - anything new you are seeing? I'm going to ask the reporter to stay away from
asking about stats specifically to a time range, but she may ask if we're seeing an increase.
Thanks so much - happy to provide more detail about the format. He will do the interview on Friday.
